concept: VPC endpoints: interface for AWS services + gateway for S3, no NAT
tests: How to give private-subnet instances access to Systems Manager and S3 without internet or a NAT gateway.
expected: Interface endpoints (PrivateLink) for Systems Manager (ssm, ssmmessages, ec2messages) + a gateway endpoint for S3. Triggers: "private subnet", "without traversing the public internet", "avoids a NAT gateway".
why_not: An IGW or public IP exposes instances to the internet; a public proxy still goes over the internet.
